label: sec:proton-gravity-tests-intro
html:
Lepton anomalies suggest a single substrate observable. We examine whether proton-radius measurements and gravitational tests probe the same parameter.

  • The Proton Radius Puzzle summarises the electronic-vs-muonic radius discrepancy and assembles the experimental table.
  • Entropic forces and the substrate parameter records the entropic-force reformulation of gravity and the supporting numerical evidence.

The section closes with the structural identification.

  • Local Value of the Substrate Parameter states the local value of q that the proton-radius and entropic data jointly imply.
  • Proof of Local Value of the Substrate Parameter supplies the proof.

This provides the foundation for the next section, which designs crystal-resonance experiments as a laboratory probe of substrate variation.
